title: Shared KV Caching for Replicated 27B Inference: Correctness Failures and Performance Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2609.15021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Shared host-memory caching can avoid repeated prefill when a request moves between inference replicas. Its usefulness depends on both correct state transfer and lost prefix locality. We study two single-GPU 27B vLLM replicas sharing a 256 GiB LMCache pool. After adopting an existing packed-page patch, we isolate a raw-pointer fallback that omits the dependency on the current CUDA stream. Controlled byte tests fail under an imposed delay and pass when the dependency is restored; the existing mixed allocator provides a working deployment path. Full-pool allocation checks and service regression complete the validation. A four-block OFF-ON-ON-OFF comparison contains 768 measured requests within two block pairs. Median cross-replica time to first content token falls from 31.715 to 0.605 seconds at 128k input and from 92.047 to 0.790 seconds at 256k. Six-turn synthetic sessions alternating replicas improve by approximately 35% and 45% at ini

translated_title: 复制式27B推理的共享KV缓存：正确性故障与性能边界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.15021v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：共享主机内存缓存可以避免请求在推理副本之间迁移时的重复预填充。其有效性同时取决于正确的状态传输以及前缀局部性的保留情况。我们研究了两个单GPU 27B vLLM副本共享一个256 GiB LMCache池的场景。在采用现有的打包页补丁后，我们隔离出一个遗漏了当前CUDA流依赖关系的裸指针回退路径。在施加人为延迟的条件下，受控字节测试失败；而恢复该依赖关系后测试通过；现有的混合分配器则提供了一条可用的部署路径。全池分配检查与服务回归测试完成了整体验证。一个四块OFF-ON-ON-OFF对比实验在两个块对内包含了768个测量请求。在128k输入下，跨副本首内容token的中位时间从31.715秒降至0.605秒；在256k输入下从92.047秒降至0.790秒。交替使用副本的六轮合成会话分别获得了约35%和45%的改进。
tldr: 本研究修复了共享KV缓存中因遗漏CUDA流依赖导致的正确性缺陷，并证明共享主机内存缓存池可将跨副本推理的首token时间从31.7秒大幅降至0.6秒，多轮会话性能提升35%至45%。
en_tdlr: This study identifies and fixes a correctness failure in shared KV caching caused by a raw-pointer fallback omitting the CUDA stream dependency, and demonstrates that a shared host-memory cache pool reduces cross-replica time-to-first-token from 31.7s to 0.6s at 128k input, improving multi-turn sessions by 35%–45%.
